_comment: Local, per-machine configuration. Treat this as a template -- fill in real paths for your machine.
local_workspace_comment: Fast local scratch disk. Artists work here directly (simulations, renders, DaVinci/Fusion caches) to avoid network bottlenecks.
shared_storage_comment: Shared storage that published/promoted assets are copied to. Can be a NAS mount path or a synced Google Drive (Mirror mode) path.
max_publish_size_gb_comment: Safety: refuse to publish if source folder is above this size (GB). 0 disables the check.
